title: The Belmont House - Sauna + Walk to 12 South!
description:
✨ Private infrared sauna, Peloton, and an unbeatable location make The Belmont House the perfect Nashville retreat. This charming 3-story townhome offers cozy living spaces, a fully equipped kitchen, and thoughtful amenities designed for comfort and relaxation. Walk to nearby shops, restaurants, live music, and local favorites, then unwind after a day exploring Broadway and the best of Music City. Perfect for family vacations, friends' getaways, business travelers, and extended stays. 🌆

The space
Things You'll Love: 

◆ Walk to the shops & restaurants of Edgehill, Hillsboro Village, + 12 South
◆ Location! Across the street from Belmont University. 
◆ Infarred Sauna + Peleton 
◆ Ensuite bathrooms for each bedroom
◆ Fully equipped kitchen with open layout
◆ Reliable Wi-Fi plus a dedicated work space. 
◆ 1 Car Garage & Plenty of Street Parking 
◆ Dog Friendly - $150 pet fee per stay for up to 2 dogs. No breed or weight restrictions.

Sleeping Arrangements:

First Floor: 
◆ Bedroom 1 - Full Bed + Ensuite Bathroom + Smart TV 

Second Floor: 
◆ Living room with a spacious couch that can sleep 2 guests + a Queen Size Air Mattress

Third Floor: 
◆ Bedroom 2 - King Bed + Private Bath + Smart TV 
◆ Bedroom 3 - King Bed + Twin Daybed + Private Bath + Smart TV 

About Hallson Hospitality

At Hallson Hospitality, we take pride in being a locally owned company, offering a portfolio of thoughtfully designed properties that adhere to the highest standards of comfort and quality. Our team of hospitality professionals is dedicated to creating seamless and unforgettable experiences for each guest.

From curated amenities to personalized service, we go the extra mile to ensure your stay is exceptional. If there’s anything we can do to enhance your visit, please don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your time with us truly unforgettable. To further elevate your stay, we offer a variety of Experience Add-ons, including early check-ins and late check-outs, private chefs, in-home massages, in-home yoga sessions, and more.

Thank you for considering The Belmont House for your upcoming trip! Be sure to add it to your Wishlist by clicking the ♥ in the upper right-hand corner, so it’s easy to find again – whether for this trip or a future stay.

Guest access
Before your arrival, we’ll send you a detailed email with all the information you need to easily locate and access the home, ensuring a smooth check-in process. This email will include a unique digital door code, customized specifically for your stay, providing secure and convenient access. If you have any questions or need assistance at any time, don’t hesitate to reach out—we’re here to make your stay as effortless and enjoyable as possible.
